title: The Roar of Nations and Sudden Terror
description: A prophetic image of the clamor of nations roaring like the sea and mighty waters. But when the Lord threatens them, they flee like chaff before the wind and dust whirls before a storm. Terror comes in the evening, and by morning they are gone—this is the fate of those who plunder and rob God's people. [ref:Jes 17:12-14|Isaiah 17:12-14]
